title: Cipher Locker: Peel the Encoded Artifact
summary: Decode a layered artifact chain: base64-wrapped manifest, a checksum-verified tar bundle, and printable strings carved from a binary, then submit the chained proof.
description: A standalone encoding and artifact-recovery lab. A read-only vault serves a base64 manifest, a tar bundle whose payload is double base64-encoded, and a binary blob with printable evidence. All data is runtime-generated and synthetic.

services.name: cipher-vault
services.purpose: Read-only server for a layered-encoding artifact chain
